clue.text: Drudge keeps following main group of men

parts.note: to dog someone is to keep following them
a body is the main group, as in the body of troops

explanation.surface: A menial worker keeps trailing behind a band of men.
explanation.definitionFit: A dogsbody is a menial worker given the dull jobs, a synonym for a drudge.

clue.text: I'm in love, but go to prison

indicators.note: in tells us the letters of I'm sit inside the word for love

parts.note: to dote is to love fondly
I'm without its apostrophe gives IM

explanation.surface: A lovestruck confession followed by a prison sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: To do time is the idiom for serving a prison sentence.

clue.text: Turn to arena, where matador may be suffering this?

parts.note: a turn in a game is a go
a ring is an arena, as for boxing or the bull

explanation.surface: Entering the bullring, a matador risks being gored.
explanation.definitionFit: Being gored by the bull's horns is the injury a bullfighter fears.

clue.text: Wait round front of registry-for her?

indicators.note: round means the word for wait goes around the other piece

parts.note: to bide is to wait

indicators.note: front of picks the opening letter of registry

explanation.surface: Someone waits at the register office for the woman they are to marry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'her' is the definition, the woman being married at the registry; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The woman getting married is a bride, so the pronoun stands for her.

clue.text: Provide free

definitions.meaning: to supply or hand over goods

explanation.definitionFit: Deliver means both to supply goods and to release or rescue someone.

clue.text: Wife-will feel our absence?

definitions.meaning: a colloquial term for one's wife
would ..., read as a two-word phrase

explanation.definitionFit: Missus is slang for a wife, and split in two it says she will miss us.

clue.text: Get into debt? Not interested

parts.note: to incur something is to get into it, as with costs
IOUs are written acknowledgements of debt

explanation.surface: Someone so uninterested they drift into owing money.
explanation.definitionFit: Incurious means lacking curiosity, showing no interest.

clue.text: Level with the flag

explanation.definitionFit: Standard means both a level of attainment and a military banner.

clue.text: Get reins moving-to do this?

indicators.note: moving suggests the letters of get reins shift into a new order

explanation.surface: Pick up the reins and set off, to guide a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking up the reins is how a rider guides a horse, which is directing its course.

clue.text: Ivan was such a bad Tsar

definitions.text: Ivan was such a bad Tsar

parts.words: Ivan was such a bad Tsar
parts.note: Ivan IV of Russia had an epithet meaning very bad, so the word describes him and means bad

explanation.definitionFit: Ivan IV of Russia is known as Ivan the Terrible, and terrible means very bad.

clue.text: Jam is a poor thing to eat on bread

definitions.meaning: a jam is a tight spot or predicament

definitions.text: a poor thing to eat on bread
definitions.meaning: a thin smear of butter, a meagre spread

explanation.definitionFit: A scrape is a predicament, and also a thinly scraped layer of butter on bread.

clue.text: Disorder in dining-hall

explanation.definitionFit: Mess means chaos, and also the room where service personnel eat.

clue.text: Tactic fellow applied to all his work

parts.note: a fellow is a man
an oeuvre is the whole body of an artist's work

explanation.surface: A strategist's method fits everything he does.
explanation.definitionFit: A manoeuvre is a clever move or ploy, much like a tactic.

clue.text: A spin-drier, that's something extra

indicators.note: spin suggests the letters of drier are whirled into another order

explanation.surface: A spin dryer offered as an added bonus.
explanation.definitionFit: A rider is an extra clause added to a document, so an addition.

clue.text: Evidence of operation of second vehicle

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Proof that a second vehicle was in service.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgery leaves a mark on the skin, so a healed wound mark shows an operation took place.

clue.text: Pursuit of the Royal Yacht?

parts.note: the court is the royal household
a yacht is a ship

explanation.surface: Chasing after the monarch's yacht.
explanation.definitionFit: Courtship is the romantic pursuit of a partner.

clue.text: Not all sport's controlled by where the Scotsman's money is

indicators.note: not all means the word sport loses its final letter

parts.note: the word as printed, without its possessive
ran means controlled, as in ran a business

explanation.surface: Not every sport is governed by where a Highlander keeps his cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is a link; the definition refers to the pouch worn with a kilt.
explanation.definitionFit: A sporran is the pouch worn at the front of a kilt, serving as a Highland purse.

clue.text: Giant firm, American, discloses bad result

indicators.note: discloses read as dis-closes, enclosing the other piece

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a loss is a bad result

explanation.surface: A huge American company reveals poor results.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discloses' is read as encloses: CO and US wrap around LOSS.
explanation.definitionFit: A colossus is a gigantic statue or person, a giant.

clue.text: Determine to avoid far worse problems

indicators.note: problems suggests the letters of far worse are in a disordered state

explanation.surface: Resolving to sidestep much bigger difficulties.
explanation.definitionFit: To forswear is to renounce or vow to give something up.

clue.text: Love the sonorous and bombastic

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
rotund can describe a full, sonorous voice

explanation.surface: Someone who adores grand, booming, pompous speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Orotund describes pompous, pretentious speech, a close match for bombastic.

clue.text: It is said to break a girl

definitions.meaning: day is said to break at first light

explanation.definitionFit: Dawn is the daybreak that is said to break, and also a woman's name.

clue.text: River of no value?

parts.note: O is a zero, nothing
use is value, as in of no use

explanation.surface: A river that is worth nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ouse is one of several English rivers of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ouse is an English river, a crossword favourite.

clue.text: Anger after being dismissed-a scandal

indicators.note: after places the word for anger behind the word for dismissed

parts.note: out means dismissed, as a batsman in cricket
rage is anger

explanation.surface: Fury after being sacked becomes a public scandal.
explanation.definitionFit: An outrage is a shocking act causing public indignation, a scandal.

clue.text: Scots girl caught idiot in fib

indicators.note: in places the word for idiot inside the word for fib

parts.note: a fib is a lie
an ass is an idiot

explanation.surface: A Scottish girl catches a fool out in a lie.
explanation.definitionFit: Lassie is Scottish dialect for a young woman.

clue.text: Trade bad-put in very brief commercial

indicators.note: put in means the short form of very goes inside the anagram
bad indicates the letters of trade are spoiled into another order

parts.note: V is the abbreviation for very

explanation.surface: Poor business leads to a short, punchy commercial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' turns TRADE into ADERT, and 'put in' sets V inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An advert is a short advertisement, a commercial.

clue.text: Ready to be filmed? Start!

explanation.definitionFit: Onset is the beginning of something; split, on set is where actors wait to be filmed.

clue.text: Bear with little Stanley's dalliance initially

parts.note: Stan is the short form of Stanley

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of dalliance

explanation.surface: Putting up with Stan's early flirting.
explanation.definitionFit: To withstand is to endure or tolerate, as to bear something.

clue.text: Good man at rugby-tight-head prop

parts.note: ST, saint, is a good man
RU is short for Rugby Union

indicators.note: head picks the first letter of tight

explanation.surface: A good player at rugby, the tight-head prop.
explanation.walkthrough: A tight-head prop is a rugby forward position, but here 'prop' is the definition, a support.
explanation.definitionFit: A strut is a structural support or brace, as is a prop.

clue.text: Spot, next to the boil

indicators.note: next to sets the word the beside the word for spot

parts.note: to spot is to see

explanation.surface: Pimples beside a boil.
explanation.definitionFit: To seethe is to bubble or churn as if boiling.

clue.text: Sweater has leaf embroidered around flower

indicators.note: around means the anagrammed letters wrap the flower
embroidered suggests the letters of leaf are worked into a new pattern

parts.note: an iris is a flower

explanation.surface: A jumper decorated with a leaf stitched around a flower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embroidered' turns LEAF into FALE, and 'around' puts it round IRIS. A Fair Isle is a patterned knitted jumper from the Shetland island.
explanation.definitionFit: A Fair Isle is a knitted jumper with a multicoloured pattern.

clue.text: Takes off football clothes

explanation.definitionFit: Strips means undresses, and a football strip is a team's kit.

clue.text: The restraint with which one should drive?

definitions.text: The restraint with which one should drive?

parts.words: The restraint with which one should drive?
parts.note: sounds like self-control behind the wheel, but means the strap worn in a car

explanation.definitionFit: A car's safety strap holds the occupant in their seat, a restraint worn when driving.
